bias.zh: 中性 · 受阻于 10 日均线和 $255.6

read.en: Amazon rose 0.6% on Oct 28 to $254.60, trading between $251.98 and $255.36. It is above the falling 5-day ($251.0), 30-day ($253.7) and 100-day ($251.9) averages and the rising 200-day ($243.4), and just below the falling 10-day ($254.7). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 23 and below zero, histogram flat; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 22 ($262.86), and RSI is 50.
read.zh: 亚马逊 10月28日上涨 0.6%，收于 $254.60，盘中区间 $251.98–255.36。股价位于下行的 5 日（$251.0）、30 日（$253.7）和 100 日均线（$251.9）以及上行的 200 日均线（$243.4）上方，略低于下行的 10 日均线（$254.7）。MACD 自 10月23日起位于信号线及零轴下方，柱状图持平；抛物线 SAR 自 10月22日起看空（$262.86），RSI 为 50。

read.en: The close held above the 30-day, now support, but the $255.4 high again stopped under the $255.6 Oct 15–16 highs. Resistance is $254.7–255.6 (10-day, those highs), then $262.9–263.7 (SAR, Oct 12 high) and $265.3 (Oct 20 high). Support is $251–252 (5 and 100-day, Oct 28 low), then $246.5–248.7 (Oct 23 and 27 lows) and $243.4–244.7. A close above $255.6 would target $263; below $251, $247.
